text: Professional Overview: The International Economics and Trade major was approved as a national first-class undergraduate major construction point in 2019. The college where this major is located usually has a profound disciplinary foundation, such as a first-level discipline doctoral program in applied economics and a postdoctoral research station.Training Objectives: To cultivate compound foreign trade and economic talents who can adapt to the development needs of China's foreign trade and economic cooperation, develop morally, intellectually, physically, aesthetically and labor, master the basic theories and skills of the major systematically, have a global perspective and strong cross-cultural communication ability, and be capable of engaging in international trade operation and management in foreign economic and trade departments, enterprises and related institutions. Emphasize the cultivation of "double high" and "two strong" talents, namely, those with high ideological and moral qualities, high professional theoretical levels, strong cross-cultural communication skills, strong practical abilities in innovation and entrepreneurship, familiar with international rules, and capable of directly participating in international cooperation and competition.Main courses: Microeconomics, Macroeconomics, Econometrics, Finance, Public Finance, Accounting, Statistics, International Economics, International Trade, Introduction to Digital Trade, International Business, International Marketing, International Business Negotiation, World Economy, International Trade Practice, International Trade Simulation Experiment, International Finance Practice, International Investment, Business English Correspondence, Introduction to China's Foreign Trade International e-commerce, international trade in services, etc.
